infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: FLOCK uses your location to find nearby experiences and help friends track each other during trips.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FLOCK uses your camera to capture trip memories.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FLOCK accesses your photos to add memories to your trips.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FLOCK uses your microphone for voice trip planning and voice memos.
